## Executive Summary

Victor Muregi is a full-stack software engineer and founder of MuregiScore Technologies based in Nairobi, Kenya. He is currently pursuing a Diploma in Computer Science (Level 6) at Kiambu National Polytechnic while actively architecting and deploying production software for Kenyan educational institutions, small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs), and commercial businesses.

Victor's engineering work focuses on solving concrete operational bottlenecks in East Africa: eliminating error-prone paper ledgers, automating fee reconciliations via Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja payment workflows, enforcing strict data isolation in multi-tenant systems, and optimizing constrained-network web applications.

---

## Technical Competencies

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, SQL, Python, HTML5, CSS3
- Frontend Architecture: React 19, Next.js (App Router, Turbopack, SSR, Static Generation), Vite, Tailwind CSS, Responsive & Mobile-First Design, Web Accessibility (WCAG / a11y)
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express, PHP (modern OOP & procedural refactoring), RESTful API design, webhook listeners & HMAC signature verification
- Databases & Data Engineering: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Relational schema design, normalization (3NF), indexes, foreign key constraints, tenant-scoped querying (`school_id`, `tenant_id`)
- Architecture & Patterns: Multi-tenant SaaS, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Constraint-Satisfaction Programming (CSP), Event-driven queues (BullMQ / Redis)
- Payment Engineering: Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja API (STK Push / Lipa na M-Pesa Online, C2B, B2C, transaction reconciliation, payment callbacks), Paystack
- DevOps & Tools: Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Linux/Unix administration, Bash scripting, Postman, Sentry error telemetry

## Flagship Products & Case Studies

### 1. EduCore — Multi-Tenant School Management Platform
- Type: Flagship Product / Production EdTech Platform
- URL: https://portfolio.muregiscore.me/projects/educore
- Problem Solved: Kenyan schools struggle with paper-based CBC (Competency-Based Curriculum) tracking, delayed fee collections, and chaotic manual report card production.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Multi-tenant data segregation ensuring strict isolation between school domains.
  - Automated report card calculation supporting CBC grading rubrics and legacy percentiles.
  - Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja integration for instant school fee payments and reconciliation.
  - Granular RBAC supporting Superadmins, Headteachers, Teachers, Bursars, and Parents.
- Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, M-Pesa Daraja API.

### 2. Core CRM — Commercial Pipeline & Intelligence System
- Type: Enterprise Business SaaS
- URL: https://portfolio.muregiscore.me/projects/core-crm
- Problem Solved: SMEs frequently lose leads and miss customer follow-ups due to fragmented WhatsApp messaging and unorganized spreadsheets.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Visual sales pipeline stages with real-time conversion velocity tracking.
  - BullMQ background workers with Redis for delayed task scheduling and notifications.
  - Multi-tier RBAC for sales reps, team managers, and company directors.
  - Comprehensive automated test suite ensuring zero regressive state transitions.
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Redis, BullMQ, PostgreSQL.

### 3. EduCore Ratiba — Constraint-Satisfaction Timetable Engine
- Type: Algorithms & Constraint-Satisfaction Engine
- URL: https://portfolio.muregiscore.me/projects/educore-ratiba
- Problem Solved: Master scheduling for schools with multiple streams, limited specialized classrooms (labs, workshops), and shared teachers often results in teacher/room clashes.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Constraint-satisfaction heuristic solver enforcing hard rules (zero teacher overlap, room capacity) and soft preferences (balanced workload).
  - Instant conflict detection and interactive drag-and-drop clash resolution.
  - Printable and exportable master timetables for teachers and students.
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, algorithmic solvers.

### 4. Sawa Solar — Renewable Energy Platform
- URL: https://portfolio.muregiscore.me/projects/sawa-solar
- Capabilities: Commercial renewable energy lead capture, solar ROI calculation, and client consultation intake.

### 5. Livestock Management — Farm Operations SaaS
- URL: https://portfolio.muregiscore.me/projects/livestock-management
- Capabilities: Agricultural health record logging, vaccination calendars, milk/yield monitoring, and inventory tracking.
